name: AspectRatio
description: Radix AspectRatio. A six-line wrapper that holds a proportional box.
intent: Reserve the right shape before the content arrives, so nothing jumps.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

notes: Purely presentational. Accessibility lives with the content you place inside.

usage: Images and video where the ratio is known
Preventing layout shift while media loads
Uniform media tiles in a grid
doNotUse: Text content, which should size to its content
When the natural dimensions are already known and set

agentRules: Children need object-cover or object-contain and full width and height.

related.note: Pair for a loading placeholder of the same shape
